text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash is feeling lost without a clear sense of direction. To get back on track, she speaks to Tokai Teio, a runner who has had her own fair share of setbacks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio explains with a smile that she found her way forward again by asking herself what the person she admires would do in her shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eishin Flash thinks of her parents, and after some consideration, she feels more optimistic about the change in her schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She decides on a new trajectory and seeks to take on a challenge even bigger than the Kikuka Sho—the Japan Cup.
